selected_gate.label: Coverage knowledge-policy behavior
selected_gate.why: It is now the smallest remaining English product-policy gate after autonomy and voicemail. A synthetic boundary probe can define allowed uncertainty, escalation, and forbidden coverage advice before any runtime or retrieval change.
selected_gate.risk: Could imply insurance coverage, eligibility, or legal/financial advice without a reviewed knowledge policy.
selected_gate.review_question: No review needed for this selection. A later probe may need human review if it asks Tarik to accept product/legal wording or coverage facts.
selected_gate.recommended_probe_scope: synthetic English coverage knowledge-policy boundary examples only
